answer.rationale: Negotiating with the incumbent using the low-cost vendor's quote as a benchmark offers the optimal balance between achieving the 18% cost reduction mandate and preserving delivery stability. Memory_c4 demonstrates successful cost recovery through renegotiation, while memory_c1 confirms the value of incumbent stability under tight production constraints (94% utilization, no buffer). Memory_c2 provides context on vendor-switching feasibility but carries unacceptable transition risk in the current environment. Verification of c2 and c4 will validate the cost-achievability of both negotiation and switch paths, but negotiation better aligns with the primary objective of minimizing TCO without increasing delivery risk.
